extraction.title: The bright bit of Britain
extraction.subtitle: How to capitalise on London’s thriving financial industry The City has bounced back despite fears over Brexit
extraction.summary: Despite economic challenges, London's financial sector remains robust, showing resilience post-Brexit. Major banks are investing in new headquarters, and the City is regaining its competitive edge in global finance. The government is encouraged to support this growth through regulatory reforms and investment strategies.
